basic_profile.bio: Based in Portland, Oregon, this user is a 27-year-old graphic designer with a passion for RPGs and indie music. They work freelance, which allows them flexible hours to engage in their hobbies. They're single and spend most evenings online, especially on weekends. They dislike overly commercialized content and are drawn to niche communities. They have a keen interest in emerging tech and often attend local gaming conventions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: The user has a deep understanding of tabletop RPGs, which stems from years of playing and DMing for friends. They also have a self-taught background in graphic design, primarily through online courses and YouTube tutorials. Recently, they've been exploring blockchain technology, which has led them to visit subs like r/xlm.
